messages:
Lena (Finance): Heads-up: we have a duplicate invoice incident for customer AtlasEdge. Two PDFs were generated with the same invoice_id but different totals. One is missing a -$5,000 reserved_capacity credit.
Omar (Billing): Found invoice ids 2026-08-AE-0044 and 2026-08-AE-0044-dup in ledger export. Totals: $42,300 vs $37,300.
InvoiceBot: job=invoice.batch run=1800123000 status=partial_fail duplicates=1 missing_lines=1 artifact=/tmp/atlasedge_diff_180012.csv
Pri (Billing-ops): I pulled the compose trace. It shows the usage CSV uploaded by vendor ETL had an extra trailing CSV column header "legacy_note" which shifted columns for some rows; the credit line relied on a tag in column 12 and got parsed into the wrong field so the compose filter dropped it.
Kai (Engineering): Reproduced locally by feeding the malformed CSV. Root cause: the CSV parser was permissive and silently shifted columns when extra fields present. Recent change to strict_parsing=false made it accept shifted rows. I'll flip strict_parsing=true and add a validation step to fail the batch if any row has unexpected column count.
Lena (Finance): We need a quick remediation for AtlasEdge only. Can we recompose and void the bad PDF before customer sees it? Also need an approval flow for the $5,000 credit — it's above our auto-approve cap.
Omar (Billing): We have targeted recompose. I'll queue recompose(account=atlasedge, run=1800123000) and create ledger note for void. Also creating a ticket for AE approval.
InvoiceBot: recompose job=1800127000 status=queued ticket=BLG-6222
Eve (Acct Exec): I got the AE approval request. Approve provisional credit of $5,000 pending signed memo. Please route draft to Legal if credit > $4,000.
Pri (Billing-ops): Recompose completed: new invoice 2026-08-AE-0044-R1 generated; reserved_capacity credit line present. Uploading sanitized artifact.
InvoiceBot: artifact=/artifacts/BLG-6222/atlasedge_sanitized_1800127000.csv uploaded
Omar (Billing): Voided duplicate invoice 2026-08-AE-0044-dup in ledger, note=voided due to malformed CSV ingestion; created credit memo draft for -$5,000 and sent to Legal as requested.
Kai (Engineering): Patch merged: set strict_parsing=true, added column-count validation, and an alert when invoice_diff > 0 for same invoice_id. Also added a lint step in vendor ETL pipeline to reject extra columns.
Lena (Finance): Approved after Legal OK. Sent corrected invoice + signed credit memo to customer and CC'd AE.
Eve (Acct Exec): Customer acknowledged receipt and accepted the credit. Thanks everyone.
Pri (Billing-ops): Adding runbook note: vendor CSVs must pass strict parse and schema checks; if failure occurs, quarantine affected accounts and run targeted recompose.
Lena (Finance): Closing loop: duplicate voided, corrected invoice issued, credit memo approved and sent, parser hardened. Reopen if any downstream tax/reporting issues.
_meta: generated_for_dataset: finance invoice generation failures; note: single Slack thread, includes bot logs, legal approval flow, vendor CSV parsing issue
